readings.moment: When the temple struck nine at dinner, as the watch inspection began
When the temple struck nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
When the temple struck ten, after Félix went to the library
When the temple struck ten, Félix's watch showed twenty to ten
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump was heard on the floor above, in the atelier
Uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes after the thump (the doubled and quick notes were not counted and give no hour)
Someone came quickly down the stairs
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and his uncle were still sitting together in the library

durations: Uncle had owned the repeater for four years
Félix's watch has given him trouble for ten years
Félix and his uncle sat together in the library from 10:32 (Félix's watch) until the temple struck eleven (about 28 minutes)
whereabouts: Félix was at the dinner table with the family when the temple struck nine; the uncle went round the table during the watch inspection
Girard and Odile were at the dinner table (Girard laughed; Odile looked at her plate)
Félix went up to the library after dinner
Félix had a glass of brandy, then another, in the library
Félix stayed in the library alone
Félix stayed where he was in the library during the thump and finished the brandy
The library is directly under the uncle's bench
An unidentified person went quickly up the stairs past the library door at about 10:15 (Félix's watch)
The thump was in the atelier, directly above the library
Félix's aunt was playing the piano downstairs when the thump came
An unidentified person came quickly down the stairs at about 10:21 (Félix's watch)
The uncle came into the library at 10:32 (Félix's watch) and sat with Félix until the temple struck eleven
